svg.text: AI/HPC PARTNER & COLOCATION DC: SITE QUALIFICATION, TURN-UP & ACCEPTANCE GATE
8-Stage DLC Turn-Up + CDU-Pod Alignment + 48h Burn-In (>=90% busbw/ICI) Hits 94.8% Efficiency
64 Racks / 7.68 MW (120kW/Rack): Tier 1 Ping-Only Handover (68d Delay, 34.5% Aborts, $920K/mo) vs. Tier 4 (9.5d, $95K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: Dirty Optics, CDU Trips & DOA Cards
1. Ping/SSH-Only Handover Without 48h Thermal Soak (34.5% Aborts):
• Infant-mortality HBM ECC errors, loose TIM cold plates & dirty
MPO-16 fiber ferrules only surface under 100% TDP collective load
2. Single-Node Smoke Tests Miss Cross-Rack Cabling Swaps (74.5%):
• Swapped Rail-3 fibers or high OCS insertion loss (>1.8 dB) cripple
multi-node AllReduce while passing single-server `nvidia-smi` checks
3. Misaligned CDU / PDU & Compute Pod Fault Domains:
• One CDU pump trip kills racks across 4 separate training slices!
Production Failure Impact (64 Racks / 7.68 MW AI Pod):
• Time from Delivery to Stable Production: 68.0 Days (Tier 1)
• Month-1 Infant-Mortality Job Aborts: 34.5% | Busbw: 61.0%
• Monthly Downtime, Re-Cabling & Cooling TCO: $920,000 / mo
🏆 Tier 4: 8-Stage Turn-Up + CDU-Pod Align + 48h Gate
1. Site Qual & Pod Fault-Domain Alignment (45–120kW+ DLC + CDU):
• Verifies `>=2,000 kg/m²` slab, `N+1 CDU` (`PG25` 25um filter), leak
interlocks & maps 1 CDU manifold strictly to 1 TPU Cube/NVL72 Pod
2. Automated LLDP Point-to-Point Audit + 48h Burn-In (>=90% Spec):
• Validates cable matrix via LLDP/BER (`<1e-12`), `DCGM L4 / HPL`,
`nccl-tests >=90% busbw` & `TPU ICI / MaxText <=2.5%` step variance
3. 4-Tier Telemetry (BMS+Redfish+Fabric+Workload) & 3% Hot Spares:
• On-site RMA buffer + `<15m` P0 Remote Hands SLA (`9.5d` turn-up)
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Turn-Up to Stable Production: 9.5 Days (-86.0% vs. Tier 1)
• Month-1 Job Aborts: 0.6% | Collective Busbw/ICI: 94.8%
• Monthly Total TCO: $95,000 / mo (-89.7% savings vs. Tier 1)
